{{Top|leg}}
A '''jolt cell Mark I''' was a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] manufactured by [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Power Cells]] that was placed in a [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] in order to modify the energy output of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. This energy cell increased the strength of the beam and allowed skilled users to increase the electrical damage done to enemies.
